ruleDefinitions.name: Renamed Office Binary Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of a renamed office binary

sequences.query: ((process_original_file_name = "Excel\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "MSACCESS\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "MSPUB\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "OneNote\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "OneNoteM\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "OUTLOOK\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "POWERPNT\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "WinWord\.exe") OR (process_description = "Microsoft\ Access" OR process_description = "Microsoft\ Excel" OR process_description = "Microsoft\ OneNote" OR process_description = "Microsoft\ Outlook" OR process_description = "Microsoft\ PowerPoint" OR process_description = "Microsoft\ Publisher" OR process_description = "Microsoft\ Word" OR process_description = "Sent\ to\ OneNote\ Tool")) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\EXCEL\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\excelcnv\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\MSACCESS\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\MSPUB\\\.EXE$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\ONENOTE\\\.EXE$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\ONENOTEM\\\.EXE$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\OUTLOOK\\\.EXE$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\POWERPNT\\\.EXE$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\WINWORD\\\.exe$")))
